headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Result Update | Sector: Retail - Jewellery SBICAP Securities Limited | 2 Key highlights of 2QFY27 result Mixed quarter with PAT growth largely driven by higher other income: Senco Gold reported mixed performance for 2QFY27 with revenue and PAT growing 34.0%/77.7% YoY to Rs 2,059 cr/Rs 87 cr respectively while EBITDA declined 15.3% YoY to Rs 90 cr due to high discounting and old-gold exchange mix.
Old-gold share rose to ~51% of retails sales by quantity during 1HFY27 which hampers margins by 20-40 bps.
PAT growth was largely driven by higher other income which rose 6.9x YoY to Rs 122 cr owing to hedging gains of Rs 103 cr during the quarter.

Senco built up substantial customer advances of Rs 750-800 cr ahead of Akshaya Tritiya and Dhanteras sales through customer offers such as Marigold scheme and Flexi gold scheme and in order to protect it from gold price risk, the company hedged these positions.
valuation: Strategic Roadmap & Vision 2030: Management reiterated its Vision 2030 target of Rs 20,000 cr in revenue, an 8% EBITDA margin and a 15%+ studded ratio, supported by an accelerated store expansion across East, North, West and Central India, with Delhi-NCR positioned as key growth market.
Store expansion will leverage both Company-Owned (COCO) and Franchisee (FOFO) models, with existing store sales targeted to nearly double over 3–4 years.

Revise rating to NEUTRAL – Estimated Fair Value at Rs 352: The quarter reflected strong business momentum but subdued earnings quality as healthy sales growth was accompanied by margin pressures and PAT growth was boosted by one-off hedge-related gains.
